test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the area of coverage in a hectare of forest and tree cover in India as per Forest Survey 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is** __80.9 million hectare__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In 2021**, the total forest and tree cover in India is 80.9 million hectares, which** is 24.62%** of the geographical area of the country. 
 
• Sharing the findings, the Minister informed that the total forest and tree cover of the country is** 80.9 million hectares.**
 
• The top three states showing an** increase** in forest cover are **Andhra Pradesh (647 sq km), Telangana (632 sq km) and Odisha (537 sq km).**
 
• An increase in forest cover has been observed in the open forest followed by a very dense forest. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​The top five States are in terms of** percentage-** **Mizoram (84.53%), Arunachal Pradesh (79.33%), Meghalaya (76.00%), Manipur (74.34%), and Nagaland (73.90%).**
 
• **Change in Recorded forest Area/Green Wash (RFA/GW) as compared to previous assessment of 2017**
 
 
• Forest cover within the RFA/GW: a slight decrease of **330 sq km (0.05%).**
 
• Forest cover outside the RFA/GW: there is an increase **of 4,306 sq km.**
 
 
 
• **Recorded forest areas** comprise Reserved Forests (RF) and Protected Forests (PF), which have been constituted under the provisions of the **Indian** **Forest Act, 1927.**
 
• There is an overall gain of** 3,976 sq km** of forest cover in the country as compared with the** ISFR 2017 report.**
